name: army_ant_mill
description: Army-ant death spiral (ant mill) from directly above: a thick closed ring of overhead-view red-brown workers three bodies deep, all running counterclockwise nose to tail, no trail in or out, a few motion ticks outside. The middle is empty and transparent. Centre anchor, x -400..400, y -400..400; ring radius 260..385, path at about r 320; the bottom-centre stretch at (0,+320) runs right and carries a standing Doug.
